sources.query: (("daridorexant"[MeSH Terms] OR "daridorexant"[Substance Name] OR "daridorexant"[Title/Abstract])) AND ("Pregnancy"[MeSH Terms] OR pregnan*[Title/Abstract] OR gestation*[Title/Abstract])
sources.caveat: Search matches, not verified human outcomes, distinct studies or evidence quality.
Registration matches; count does not establish posted results, enrollment, outcomes or confirmed age-band applicability.
LactMed is lactation-only; it is not pregnancy or general pediatric evidence.
Name-matched product labels; count does not establish population-specific sections, current FDA approval or independent evidence.
Literal drug-name row matches in selected snapshot tables; no name resolution or full portals. Pediatric broad matches do not confirm a narrower requested age band. Rows are not distinct studies.

evidence.notice: Presence/count navigation only. Counts are not comparable across sources and cannot establish evidence quality, clinical safety or what the studies found. Zero matches may reflect query, indexing, snapshot or population limits.

population_coverage.notice: Search bands are prototype conventions, not clinical equivalence. Preserve actual source ages, gestational age and prematurity. A broad pediatric record does not establish evidence for the requested band.

evidence.continuity_of_care_notice: Stopping or changing a medication can also carry risks. Discuss changes with the prescribing clinician. This tool cannot advise starting, stopping, or changing treatment.

framing_contract.instruction: When reporting adverse findings, retain relevant source context on treatment benefits, underlying disease and consequences of changing treatment if available. Disclose missing context; do not invent reassurance. Accurate facts can still induce inappropriate stopping. Clinical review remains necessary.

evidence_status.message: Retrieved material is not a safety verdict; missing evidence is not evidence of safety.

dose_or_administration.client_action: Suppress flagged fields or visibly caveat them as historical source content, never personal instructions.
dose_or_administration.detection_limit: Heuristic; an unflagged field is not certified free of dosing content.

removed_pregnancy_letter_categories.instruction: A/B/C/D/X pregnancy letter categories were removed by FDA PLLR. Preserve as historical source text only; never present as the current classification.

pregnancy_coverage_notice.message: This prototype did not identify a curated federal pregnancy counterpart to LactMed. Pregnancy findings come from product labeling and primary literature; coverage is not exhaustive. LactMed is a lactation resource, not a pregnancy evidence substitute.
pregnancy_coverage_notice.finding_scope: Source-review finding, not proof that no such resource could exist.

safety.scope: Public evidence and resource navigation; not individual treatment or eligibility decisions.
rules: Do not infer safety, drug identity, or absence of evidence from missing or empty results.
Do not provide doses, missed-dose plans, schedules, tapers or personal start/stop/change decisions.
Separate source findings, monitoring recommendations, exposure measurements and causal claims.
Call route_parent_question before parent-facing chat; urgent concerns take precedence over retrieval.
Do not collect identifiable histories or submit reports, comments or enrollment applications.

result.disclaimer: Informational only; not medical advice. Compiled from public NIH/NLM/FDA data, which may be incomplete or out of date. Patients should talk to a clinician, pharmacist or poison control before starting, stopping or changing any medication.
